explanation_full: This model is a K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) model trained on data related to HRT 12 -4 h. It achieved the highest accuracy among various models tested, reaching 81.7%.  The most influential features for prediction are VFA, Butyrate and Acetate, as indicated by the feature importance analysis. The model's performance is further evaluated through metrics like RMSE (0.113) and MAE (0.075). Visualizations of the feature importance and model comparison with other algorithms are available in the artifacts section.  The model's performance suggests its potential for predicting outcomes related to HRT 12 -4 h based on these key features. Further analysis and validation are recommended to fully understand its capabilities and limitations in real-world applications.
